extracted.intended_audience: merchants, surveyors, architects, mathematicians and students of arithmetic/geometry (Renaissance Italian readership)
extracted.subtask_description: A full-text edition / excerpt of a Renaissance-era treatise (Summa de Arithmetica, Geometria, Proportioni) describing arithmetic, geometry, proportions, merchant practice, measurement methods, and applied problems for commerce, surveying, architecture, music and mechanics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trattazione delle operazioni numeriche (Arithmetic operations)
rubrics_metrics.description: "tratta de numeri in tutti modi ... partire:multiplicare:rummare:fotrare: e d'estrazione de radici" — the book treats numbers in all ways including basic operations and extraction of roots.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains algorithms and worked examples for addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, extraction of roots and related arithmetical procedures; intended for both practical (mercantile) and speculative uses and presented with algorithms and geometrical/arithmetical proofs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proportioni e proportionalità (Proportions and proportionality)
rubrics_metrics.description: Original heading: "Proportioni e proportionalita" — dedicated treatment of proportion and proportionality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develops definitions and canonical propositions on proportion; shows applications in music, astronomy, mechanics, architecture and commerce; includes methods for solving proportional problems and construction of proportional tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regole mercantili (Merchant rules / commercial arithmetic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Referenced as "la regola mercantfea ... con casi esemplari per ... guadagni perdite ... transportationi" — practical mercantile rules and examples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical problems for trade: calculation of prices, gains and losses, exchange, transport, tariffs, conversions of measures and currencies; worked merchant examples and canonical 'rules' for everyday commerce.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contabilità pratica: quaderno, giornale, debiti e crediti (Bookkeeping / accounts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Descriptions in the 'terza parte' about "regole, modi, verbi e vie per faper etener tutti conti e feripture ... quaderno, con suo giornale, memoria" and explanation of debit/credit columns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prescribes ledger practice: keeping a journal and notebook (quaderno), marking debit and credit lines, recording transports and carts, summarizing at the end of the treatise; includes examples and instructions for merchant accounting procedure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Misura di superfici piane (Measurement of plane figures / areas)
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple statements: "modo a meturare tutte le superfidc quadrate"; "modo a trouare la area ... le figure quadrilatere ... triangoli" — methods to measure areas of squares, triangles, quadrilaterals and other polygons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives constructional and practical methods (geometric and arithmetic) to compute areas of different plane figures, with worked examples and tables for use in trade, land measurement and craft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Misura dei solidi e dei volumi (Measurement of solids / volumes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Passages such as "modo a fap mefurare vn solido rettagolote ... cubi ... piramidi ... la capacita coppale" describing methods to measure solids (cubes, prisms, pyramids) and capacities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for computing volumes and capacities of solids; includes practical applications to casks, vats, architectural elements; formulas, decomposition methods and tabulated conversions for craftsmen and merchants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Misura di botti, barili e contenitori (Measuring casks, barrels and vessels)
rubrics_metrics.description: Long practical section on measuring barrels and vessels: references to 'botte', 'barili', 'boccali', 'ftagiuoli', methods of copying shapes, dividing into units, and building merchant tables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Step‑by‑step practical instructions (including templates and procedures) for determining capacities of casks and barrels, how to standardize measures, how to create tables for different local types of casks and how to record them in merchant practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Misura e rilievo di campi, montagne e valli (Surveying / land measurement)
rubrics_metrics.description: "bel modo afap mefurare le fuperficie iti monti e valli" — methods for measuring irregular terrain and inaccessible lands.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Techniques for surveying mountainous or valley terrain using geometrical methods and instruments, approximations for inaccessible distances, and application to land valuation and division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uso degli strumenti: compasso, gnomone, circolo, riga (Instruments and instruments-based methods)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mentions of instruments: "gnomonem, circinum, rectim dinembpeni ... compasso" and 'strumenti' applicable to different measurements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the instruments required (compass, straightedge, gnomon, circinus, etc.), how to apply them to constructions and measurements, and when to prefer instrument methods vs. arithmetic/tabular methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tavole e tabulationi per misure e cambi (Tables for measures, proportions and currencies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Repeated mention of 'tauola', 'tavola ... frequente retroverai', and tables for measures, proportions and merchant conversions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides or instructs creation/use of lookup tables (multiplication, proportion, measure and currency conversion tables) intended to speed computation in commerce, construction and practical arts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proporzione applicata alla musica e armonia (Proportion in music / harmonics)
rubrics_metrics.description: References connecting proportion to melody and music: 'la musica ... numero miftura ... proporzione ... fa' la melodia'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how numerical proportions underlie musical intervals and composition; shows how proportional reasoning applies to tuning and melodic composition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concezioni euclidee e dimostrazioni geometriche (Euclidean constructions & proofs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Frequent references to Euclid: 'De' Euclide ... tutte le conclusioni ... le eddufidi e demollrati di ogni libro di Euclide' and adoption of Euclidean demonstrations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presents classic Euclidean propositions and demonstrations as foundations; uses them to justify constructions and measurement rules given later in the treatise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicazioni all'architettura, macchine e fortificazioni (Applications to architecture, mechanics, military engineering)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mentions 'architettura ... macchine ... munizioni ... castellum ... bombarde' and the use of number, measure and proportion in machines and fortifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives concrete applications: drawing plans, measuring building parts, designing machines and military works; emphasizes practical examples where geometric and arithmetical methods guide construction and engineering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentazione in volgare per uso pratico (Vernacular pedagogy / accessibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicit statement: presentation 'in maternal e vernacula lengua' to bring mathematics to those who cannot understand Latin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended pedagogical choice: explain mathematical doctrine in the vernacular to widen accessibility; simpler phrasing and practical examples to teach merchants, craftsmen, and non‑Latin readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Struttura didattica: partizioni e distinctiones (Didactic structure: parts and distinctions)
rubrics_metrics.description: The book repeatedly lists parts and 'distinctio' (prima, seconda, terza ...), and a detailed table-of-contents listing objectives for each distinction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizational rubric: break the material into principal parts (arithmetica, proportion, geometry, merchant practice) and numbered distinctions/subsections each with specified learning objectives (e.g., how to measure, how to divide, how to tabulate).
